description: This file defines the BluetoothChatService class, which manages Bluetooth connections for a chat application on Android. It handles establishing server and client connections, managing data transmission streams, and maintaining connection states through multiple threads.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth connection lifecycle, including listening for incoming connections, initiating outgoing connections, handling data transmission, and managing connection states.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService.AcceptThread
classes.description: Thread that runs as a server socket listening for incoming Bluetooth connections.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService.ConnectThread
classes.description: Thread that attempts to establish an outgoing Bluetooth connection to a specified device.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService.ConnectedThread
classes.description: Thread that manages an active Bluetooth connection, handling data read/write operations.

methods.name: updateUserInterfaceTitle
methods.description: Updates the UI with the current connection state via Handler messages.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current Bluetooth connection state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the Bluetooth listening threads, setting up the service to accept connections.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Starts a thread to connect to a specified Bluetooth device.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Sets up a thread to manage an active connection after a connection has been established.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates all connection and listening threads, stopping the service.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data through the active Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: connectionFailed
methods.description: Handles a failed connection attempt, notifies UI, and restarts listening.

methods.name: connectionLost
methods.description: Handles loss of an active connection, notifies UI, and restarts listening.
